CustomField.description: Filled by the website lead form from the utm_campaign URL parameter. Not edited by hand. Stores the ad platform's campaign name as text. This is not the Salesforce Campaign: the lead Flow assigns that from UTM Medium. Mapped to the Opportunity on conversion.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The name of the ad campaign that sent this lead, as written in the ad's URL. Set automatically by the website form.
CustomField.label: UTM Campaign
